title: Nvidia reinstates Huang as CEO after Trump intervention
hook: Nvidia reinstates Huang as CEO after Trump intervention

beats.caption: Nvidia reinstates Huang as CEO after Trump intervention
Jensen Huang is back as CEO of Nvidia.
beats.detail: The company reversed the resignation on Monday.
beats.narration: CEOs usually stay gone after a scandal. This one returned in two weeks.

beats.caption: Huang left amid espionage concerns regarding China.
beats.detail: US intelligence agencies raised the alarm.
beats.narration: Jensen Huang resigned two weeks ago. It followed reports of an affair with a potential spy.

beats.caption: Trump claims direct board contact caused this.
beats.detail: The president says he pushed for reinstatement.
beats.narration: Now the board has reversed course. Donald Trump says he intervened directly to make it happen.

data.left_text: Huang leaves after affair with possible spy
data.right_text: Trump says he spoke to the board directly

beats.caption: Wall Street is reacting to the news.
beats.detail: Nvidia stock volatility remains a major concern.
beats.narration: His departure originally sent Wall Street into a tailspin. Investors are watching closely to see what changes.

beats.caption: Eleven independent sources confirm the news.
beats.detail: Reporting spans BBC, Wired, and France 24.
beats.narration: This story is confirmed across eleven independent outlets. It is a major shift for the tech giant.

beats.caption: Corporate governance questions are now rising.
beats.detail: The board faces scrutiny over this decision.
beats.narration: We do not know the full details of the board talks. Questions about corporate governance remain.
